other_conditions: Applicant must be a day‑scholar resident of West Bengal
Must be a regular full‑time student studying in a Government, Government‑aided or Government‑recognized school in West Bengal
Must belong to the Scheduled Caste category
Annual family income must not exceed Rs 2.5 lakhs
Applicant must not be receiving any other scholarship or stipend for the same period
Applicant must have a bank account in a nationalized bank with core‑banking facilities
Scholarship is granted for one year only per class; a student repeating a class is not eligible for a second year of scholarship for that class
Continuation of the award is subject to good conduct, attendance, and meeting eligibility criteria in subsequent years
benefits_summary: Provides a yearly financial assistance of ₹750 for classes V‑VII and ₹800 for class VIII, disbursed directly to the student’s bank account.
